answer_1.quote: In this work, we propose SEAL, a novel training objective with an abstention mechanism, enabling the model to selectively reject tokens that misalign with the desired knowledge distribution
answer_1.outputs: The model generates responses to factual questions, both in short-form and long-form settings, and may output a [REJ] token during training to indicate knowledge misalignment.

answer_2.quote: In the short-form QA task, we leverage accuracy (Acc.) to measure the extent of LLM hallucinations.
